module.purpose: Provides shared edge geometry, visibility, layering, identification, insertion, and reconnection utilities for the graph system.
module.summary: This module contains stateless TypeScript helpers for calculating edge centers and viewport visibility, determining rendered z-indexes, generating stable edge identifiers, validating connections, adding edges without duplicates, and reconnecting existing edges. It operates on node, connection, and edge structures while preserving immutable edge-array updates and reporting invalid operations through configurable error callbacks.
module.businessContext: Supports graph and workflow editing where visual edges connect nodes and users can add or reconnect them. Failures can produce incorrect diagrams or silently lose relationship updates.
functions: getEdgeCenter (~L6-24): Calculates midpoint coordinates and axis offsets between edge endpoints
getElevatedEdgeZIndex (~L39-49): Computes edge layering from node hierarchy and selection state
isEdgeVisible (~L59-77): Determines whether an edge bounding box overlaps the viewport
getEdgeId (~L91-92): Generates a deterministic identifier from connection endpoints and handles
connectionExists (~L94-102): Checks whether equivalent source and target handles already exist
addEdge (~L128-164): Validates, normalizes, deduplicates, and immutably appends an edge
reconnectEdge (~L200-235): Replaces an existing edge connection while preserving edge properties

mutationOfArg: isEdgeVisible adjusts the locally created edge bounding box when either dimension is zero.
addEdge deletes null sourceHandle and targetHandle properties from its copied edge object.

detail.name: getEdgeCenter
preconditions: sourceX, sourceY, targetX, and targetY are numbers.
postconditions: Returns a four-element tuple [centerX, centerY, xOffset, yOffset].
centerX is the arithmetic midpoint of sourceX and targetX.
centerY is the arithmetic midpoint of sourceY and targetY.
xOffset equals Math.abs(targetX - sourceX) / 2 and yOffset equals Math.abs(targetY - sourceY) / 2.
invariants: xOffset and yOffset are non-negative for finite numeric coordinates.
The center coordinates are equidistant from their corresponding source and target coordinates.
edgeCases: When source and target coordinates are equal on an axis, the corresponding center coordinate equals that coordinate and the offset is 0.
When source coordinates are greater than target coordinates, the midpoint is computed identically using the target coordinate plus the offset.
When a coordinate is NaN, the corresponding offset and center coordinate are NaN.
Infinite coordinate inputs propagate according to JavaScript numeric arithmetic and Math.abs semantics.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit runtime validation; values are processed using JavaScript numeric arithmetic.

detail.name: addEdge
detail.signature: export const addEdge = <EdgeType extends EdgeBase>(edgeParams: EdgeType | Connection, edges: EdgeType[], options: AddEdgeOptions = {}): EdgeType[]
preconditions: edgeParams is an EdgeType or Connection value.
edges is an array of EdgeType values.
For normal addition, edgeParams.source and edgeParams.target are truthy.
postconditions: Returns an edge array containing the new edge when the connection does not already exist.
A Connection input is converted to an EdgeType-shaped value with an ID generated by options.getEdgeId or the default edge ID generator.
An EdgeType input is shallow-copied before being added.
If an equivalent connection already exists, returns the existing edges array unchanged.
If source or target is missing or falsy, returns the existing edges array unchanged.
invariants: An edge is not added when another edge has the same source and target and matching targetHandle and sourceHandle values when those handles are set.
The input edges array is not mutated in place.
Duplicate and invalid-input paths preserve the original edges array reference.
edgeCases: When edgeParams.source or edgeParams.target is falsy, the optional onError callback is invoked with error code 006 and the original edges array is returned.
When an equivalent source-target connection already exists, no new edge is added even if the candidate edge has a different id.
When edgeParams is a Connection rather than an EdgeType, its id is generated using options.getEdgeId when provided, otherwise the default generator is used.
When no duplicate exists, the returned array contains all existing edges followed by the new edge.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: For a missing or falsy source or target, invoke options.onError if present with '006' and the corresponding error message, then return the original edges array.

detail.summary: Adds an edge or connection to the current edge array unless its endpoints and handles already identify an existing connection. Invalid endpoint data is reported through the optional error callback and leaves the input array unchanged.

specLiterals.role: Error code supplied to options.onError when source or target is missing.

detail.name: reconnectEdge
detail.signature: export const reconnectEdge = <EdgeType extends EdgeBase>(oldEdge: EdgeType, newConnection: Connection, edges: EdgeType[], options: ReconnectEdgeOptions = { shouldReplaceId: true }): EdgeType[]
preconditions: edges is an array of edges of type EdgeType.
options, when supplied, conforms to ReconnectEdgeOptions.
postconditions: For a valid connection and an edge found by oldEdge.id, the matching edge is replaced with an edge using the new source, target, sourceHandle, and targetHandle values.
The replacement preserves the old edge's properties other than id and connection endpoint fields.
The returned array contains the updated edge collection in the original ordering.
When options.shouldReplaceId is true, the replacement receives an identifier generated from the new connection; otherwise it retains the old identifier.
invariants: The input edges array is not mutated in place.
Edges other than the one identified by oldEdge.id are preserved.
The returned edge retains EdgeType-compatible shape.
edgeCases: If newConnection.source is falsy or newConnection.target is falsy, the function invokes options.onError with error code '006' when provided and returns the original edges array.
If no edge in edges has the same id as oldEdge.id, the function invokes options.onError with error code '007' and the old edge id when provided, then returns the original edges array.
If options is omitted, shouldReplaceId defaults to true.
If options.onError is absent, invalid-input and missing-edge conditions still return the original edges array without invoking a callback.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns the original edges array and optionally calls onError with error code '006' when the new connection lacks a source or target.

detail.summary: Replaces an existing edge with the supplied connection while preserving the existing edge's other properties. Invalid connections and unknown edge identifiers leave the input edge array unchanged and may notify the configured error callback.
